## Smart manual next-episode fallback

- Add Smart beside Off, Percentage and Time in the manual next-episode prompt settings.
- Analyze at most 31 cached thumbnails on the configured interval in the final five minutes. Require consecutive mostly-black frames with multiple text-like lines; show Play Next Episode one interval before the first matching frame.
- Use existing cache only, bounded background image analysis and one decoded image at a time. Require Seek Thumbnails; missing frames are retried without downloading anything.
- Keep valid IntroDB markers authoritative. Smart only offers a manual button, never an automatic countdown or episode change.

Credits recognition is a heuristic, not guaranteed detection. Short videos (five minutes or less) do not use Smart detection.
